headline: legal-explainers rises 85 to 93; side-hustles breakout rate falls to 58%
paragraphs: Biggest score move since yesterday: legal-explainers rose from 85 to 93 (breakout rate 56% to 63%; typical best outlier 6.1x to 7.8x). disasters went from 78 to 80; business-case-studies and medieval-history each fell 2 points. personal-finance held at 92, the top score.

side-hustles kept its score of 87, but its breakout rate fell from 69% to 58%. In legal-explainers 8 of the top 12 videos come from Logic vs. Liability (1,790 subscribers). In tax-strategy 4 of the top 12 are election or ballot-proposition explainers, not tax topics.

Notable outliers: FibreandMatrix at 2,561.2x (4,542,216 views, 3,160 subscribers) and a new EverythingXplained Short at 1,064.9x (69,753 views, 2,750 subscribers). No niches added: this week's trend pages name only formats already tracked. Thumbnails not viewable; titles only.
